facts.fact: For rail visitors viaOkayama, transfer to a conventional Sanyo or Hakubi service to Kurashiki; Shin-Kurashiki requires a Sanyo connection toward Kurashiki.

facts.fact: The road up to the shrine is narrow, with pedestrian/local traffic; a vehicle approach does not establish an accessible, stepfree visiting route.
facts.excerpt: 当社へ上がる車道は狭い
